name: io.github.agentoprimus/public-records
title: Public Records for Agents (Federal Register + White House review)
description: Pay-per-call US regulatory data: Federal Register search + White House (OIRA) review tracker.

tools.name: federal_register_search
tools.description: Search the US Federal Register (rules, proposed rules, notices, presidential documents) via the official API. Filters: agency slug, type, publication date range, open_for_comment. Returns comment deadlines, docket IDs and regulations.gov comment links. $0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

agency.description: Federal Register agency slug, e.g. environmental-protection-agency

open_for_comment.description: Only documents whose comment period has not closed

tools.name: white_house_rule_review
tools.description: Federal rules currently under White House OIRA review (EO 12866) or that concluded review in the last 30 days, from reginfo.gov data refreshed daily. Review usually comes shortly before publication in the Federal Register, so this is an early signal. Recent items include linked Federal Register documents and, for concluded reviews, whether the rule has been published since. Filters: status, agency, stage, title query, since date, economically_significant. $0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base).

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD; received or concluded on/after this date

stage.description: e.g. Proposed Rule, Final Rule, Interim Final Rule

agency.description: Agency name or acronym substring, e.g. EPA or Food and Drug
